meta.disclaimer: MOCK REPORT for demonstration. Comparable prices are real Lamudi asking prices as of 19 October 2026, not closed sales. An indicative price screen, not an appraisal or investment advice.

indicative.label: Marginal — fairly priced
indicative.headline: Marginal: asked at ₱42,000/sqm, inside the comparable range of ₱30,000–₱50,000 and in the upper half (5% over the middle). Fair pricing; the upside has to come from negotiation or the use.

metrics.label: Asking price per sqm
metrics.formula: Compared with comparable listings ₱30,000–₱50,000 per sqm

metrics.label: Total asking price
metrics.formula: Asking price per sqm × lot area (both approximate)

metrics.label: Discount vs comparables
metrics.formula: (Comparable price − asking) ÷ comparable price, at the comparable low, middle and high. Negative = premium.

metrics.label: Seller's proceeds after commission
metrics.formula: Total asking × (1 − 3% commission), before capital gains tax and other closing costs

screening_rule.label: Asking price per sqm against comparable listings
screening_rule.note: Below the comparable low = Promising; inside the range = Marginal; above the comparable high = Weak.

inputs.label: Comparable range
inputs.value: ₱30,000–₱50,000 per sqm: C6-frontage and C6-access lots (S-002)

inputs.label: BIR zonal value
inputs.value: Not published online; to confirm with the BIR

inputs.label: Papers
inputs.value: Title, zoning and site studies offered on inquiry

flags.label: BIR zonal value not published online. Confirm it with the BIR; capital gains and documentary stamp taxes are generally based on the higher of the price and the zonal or fair market value.
Lakeshore location: lowland areas along Laguna de Bay are flood-susceptible. Check elevation and flood history.
Comparables are asking prices from listings, not closed sales.

notes: Evidence: 12 comparable lot listings within about 1.2 km, gathered 19 October 2026. The subject is 20% above the ₱35,000 median of all nearby listings, and in the upper half of the C6-frontage range.
Its direct C6 frontage and 1.4 ha size are scarce: few listed parcels over 10,000 sqm sit on C6 itself.

upgrade_path.label: Certified true copy of the title

limitations.reason: Market evidence is asking prices and asking rents from online listings on 19 October 2026, not closed transactions. Closed prices are typically lower.
limitations.how_to_resolve: Obtain closed-sale evidence or a licensed appraisal before negotiating.

limitations.reason: Zoning has not been confirmed. The listing states that title, zoning and site studies are available on serious inquiry.
limitations.how_to_resolve: Request the zoning certificate or locational clearance from the Taguig City zoning office.

limitations.reason: The BIR zonal value for the site is not published in the online sources checked.
limitations.how_to_resolve: Confirm the zonal value with the BIR Revenue District Office covering Taguig.
